decision.title: Decision Analysis
decision.description: A saved Arbitr decision analysis document stored in Firestore

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this decision

title.description: The title of the decision (e.g., Job Offer A vs. Job Offer B)

options.description: Array of objects with option names, criteria, weights, and scores

verdict.description: The final recommendation or winning option name

summary.description: Short explanation of why the recommended option won

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the decision was saved

/decisions/{decisionId}.description: Top-level collection of decisions owned by authenticated users

/users/{userId}/decisions/{decisionId}.description: User-scoped collection of decisions for user document synchronization
